items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Only on record you see I never heard the band with Alfred on drums and Joe Watkins

ctx.x: He wasn't much like that I'm telling you he wasn't much
Only on record you see I never heard the band with Alfred on drums and Joe Watkins
Now you know who was a rough fella and had a nice band maybe you didn't hear him? Chris Kelly Never heard him no
